data.description:
## Problem

The DSO ticket CLI has no way to change a ticket's parent_id after creation. `ticket edit` supports retyping (`--ticket_type`) but not `--parent`. The only current workaround is delete + recreate, which discards:
- the original ticket ID (breaks external references)
- event-sourced history (creation, status transitions, comments)
- inbound bridge SYNC markers (jira-dig-* mirror linkage)
- dependency links from other tickets

## Why now

The 2026-05-12 ticket health audit identified ~31 hash-id orphan tasks/stories that have a plausible epic parent based on title/topic clustering — they appear to be cases where the original parent-link command failed at creation time. Reparenting them via the CLI would lift the orphan warning count and restore navigability, but the operation is blocked on this missing command.

## Scope

Stories to plan under this epic:
1. Implement `ticket reparent <id> <new-parent>` subcommand that emits a REPARENT event, validates the new parent exists, prevents cycles, and updates the children index.
2. Apply reparents to the 31 hash-id orphan candidates (clusters under epics `af26-dd5a`, `ed62-08cd`, `6068-cb2d`, `4100-95a4`, `e22e-b7a2`, `jira-dig-2167`).
3. Hand-review the remaining ~13 weaker-match orphans and either reparent or tag `standalone`.

## Success criteria
- `ticket reparent` command lands with event-sourced history preserved.
- Orphan warning count in validate-issues.sh drops by ~40 (hash-id orphans only; jira-dig orphans tracked separately under bug `36cf-48d7`).
- No accidental wrong-parent assignments (every reparent reviewed individually before commit).

## Out of scope
- Reparenting jira-dig-* tickets (blocked on inbound parent_id ingest fix — see bug `36cf-48d7`).
data.title: Add ticket reparent CLI command + bulk orphan remediation
